# Regionshospitalet Nordjylland

Regionshospitalet Nordjylland is a Danish hospital named in the 2023 annual report of the Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark (AFDK), a national quality registry for atrial fibrillation care run under the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP)[^src1]. It is specifically identified as the workplace of [[albert-marni-joensen|Albert Marni Joensen]], overlæge, ph.d., who serves as a member of the AFDK steering group (styregruppe)[^src1][^src2]. A more precise mention elsewhere in the report locates the hospital's relevant site as "Regionshospitalet Nordjylland, Hjørring"[^src2].

The AFDK report covers atrial fibrillation treatment quality across Danish public hospitals for the period 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023, drawing on data from 19,671 incident patients and 134,810 prevalent patients reported to the Landspatientregisteret[^src1]. Within this broader national picture, Regionshospitalet Nordjylland's significance in the corpus rests on its role as the institutional base of a named steering group member rather than on any direct performance data attributed to the hospital itself. No further claims, timeline events, or additional relationships involving this hospital appear in the supplied material.
